summary: This increment adds a browser-execution-tier orchestration layer (tier-detection.ts, tier-orchestrator.ts, client-compile.ts) plus a new authenticated /api/prompt-compiler/execute route, and wires both existing composer send paths (Option 1 chain dispatch, Option 2 discuss chat) to a fire-and-forget browser-to-server handoff. The architecture is sound: tier detection/selection is a pure, injectable-env function with real unit coverage; the new API route correctly uses requireAuth()/Drizzle, treats client-supplied browserCompiled telemetry as strictly non-authoritative (it never substitutes client data for the server's own recomputed classification), and the two runBrowserFirstPass() call sites are on disjoint code branches (chain-mode vs. discuss-mode), so there's no double-fire. The prompt-construction.ts/prompt-hash.ts split cleanly isolates the node:crypto dependency so analyzeLightweight() can run in a browser bundle, with backward-compatible re-exports verified to have no leftover unused-import references. ai-os/OS.yaml's new index entry parses as valid YAML. No changes touch .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema files, auth/permission/payment/billing/rls paths, or .env files, consistent with the tier1 classification. Could not execute bun test/tsc locally (bun unavailable in this review sandbox), so the worker's own reported green test/build results are unverified by direct re-run here, but manual reading of the diff finds no correctness or security defects.
